youtube.title: Kumbhakarna ne maanga kuch aur, mila kya? 😴 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Ravana ke bhai Kumbhakarna ne Gokarna mein kathin tapasya ki. Brahma ji prasann hue, par devta chintit the ki ye vardan paakar sab kuch nigal jayega. Tab Devi Saraswati Kumbhakarna ki jeebh par virajman huin.

Vo maangna chahta tha devtva, par jeebh se nikla nidra. Brahma ji ne tathastu kaha, aur usi din se Kumbhakarna ki lambi neend shuru ho gayi. Lok kathaon mein ise chhah mahine ki neend kaha jaata hai.

Katha ka strot: Valmiki Ramayana, Uttara Kanda, sarg dus.
